description: Renovate only bumps the compose.yaml build args that Dependabot cannot see; Dependabot keeps handling Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions and uv.

customManagers.description: Versions and image tags annotated with `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...`
Commit SHAs pinned to the head of a branch, annotated with `# renovate: datasource=git-refs depName=<url> branch=<branch>`

packageRules.description: Keep DOCKER_IMAGE_TAG_UV and the uv BASE_IMAGE tag in sync in one PR.
Follow Claude Code's `stable` release channel (npm dist-tag) instead of `latest`.
GitHub release tags carry a `v` prefix that the build args omit.
Stay on Betterleaks v1.x until v2 is stable; see the Betterleaks comment in the Dockerfile.
Only plain `X.Y.Z` tags, not `-slim`, `-alpine`, `-<date>` and so on.
prBodyNotes: Re-check the vendored urllib3 copies of gsutil and bq (see the Trivy blind-spot comment in the Dockerfile).

packageRules.description: Keep the Ubuntu release suffix (e.g. `-resolute`) and skip the per-arch tags.
Keep the minor version the same as Ubuntu's default python3 of the Playwright BASE_IMAGE; only the patch version is brought up to date.
